text:
maya: Hey team — first-day CI pain. I pushed a fix branch and Buildkite job never started, GitHub shows the Check run stuck at 'queued'.

sam: Welcome! Is the Buildkite GitHub App installed on the repo/org?

maya: I thought so. Settings > Integrations shows Buildkite app installed for org, but the pipeline list on BK UI is empty for me. No builds triggered when I pushed.

rui: Common issue: GH app needs repo access granted per-repo after org install. Check https://github.com/organizations/ORG/settings/installations

maya: Ah ok, I didn't see that. I checked and the app is installed, but it says "This app is not installed on this repository" on the repo's integrations page.

olivia: Also check the repo webhooks: sometimes our GH Actions -> BK webhook mapping was replaced. In repo > webhooks you should see a Buildkite webhook. If missing, re-install or add permissions.

maya: I re-added the repo access and tried pushing again. Still nothing. Buildkite pipeline shows "No recent builds" and in GH the check shows "pending" with no logs.

sam: Can you paste the pipeline slug and repo full name? I'll check our org-level Installations and the pipeline settings.

maya: repo=redwood-inference/web-portal, pipeline=portal-internal

sam: Looking now. The pipeline is set to use GITHUB_COM provider, but the pipeline's "Build triggers" are disabled because the pipeline token env var is missing. You need the BUILDKITE_PIPELINE_TOKEN in the repo secrets or pipeline env.

maya: Where does that token come from? I don't have access to secrets yet.

olivia: It's generated in Buildkite when the pipeline is created. For onboarding, we have a shared secret manager entry. @sam can you send the token to maya via DM or add a temporary one?

sam: Sent you a secure note in 1Password and added a placeholder secret in the pipeline. Try pushing again.

maya: Pushed a new commit. Buildkite shows a new build started :tada:

devops-bot: Build #24 for portal-internal started by maya (git push)

maya: Build failed on tests with `ERROR: missing GITHUB_TOKEN` in the checkout step.

rui: That one is GH Actions style. Our BK pipelines sometimes call GH API so they expect GITHUB_TOKEN in env. For clones we use BK's built-in checkout; for GH API calls the token must be provided. If you hit that error in a script step, add `secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN` to pipeline env or use the oauth token.

maya: Got it. Adding GITHUB_TOKEN from the onboarding vault.

maya: New build passed the checkout step and is now running tests. Thanks all! Super quick help. :raised_hands:

olivia: For checklist we should add to onboarding doc: 1) Confirm Buildkite app has per-repo access, 2) Ensure pipeline token present, 3) Check repo webhooks, 4) Add GITHUB_TOKEN if pipeline scripts call GH API. I'll make a PR to devex onboarding guide.

maya: Perfect. Tag me on the PR for next steps.

sam: 👍
